newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR STARTS THURSDAY MIXED ON UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR STARTS THURSDAY MIXED ON UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted easier on the U.S. dollar but registered slight gains against sterling, the mark and the rand in fairly quiet early Thursday trade, foreign exchange dealers said.
"The market is still fairly kind of stable at the moment. We haven't seen any major deals coming in yet," commented one dealer.
At around 0845 GMT, the Zimbabwe dollar was trading at 11.2945/3045 on the U.S. dollar after closing Wednesday's interbank session at 11.2925/3025.
It was however quoted firmer on the crosses; at 18.5260 from 18.6350/6600 versus sterling, at 6.6605/6705 against the mark from 6.6675/6755 and at 2.5280/5380 on the rand from 2.5320/55.
